The Creatine  Hardcore Advantage
Team MuscleTech, the world leader in bodybuilding nutrition, has made it their mission to scientifically research, develop, and engineer the most groundbreaking supplements for rapid muscle growth, maximum strength gains, and extreme fat burning.

To date, not other brand is backed by as many clinical studies as Team Muscle Tech products are - proof of the effectiveness of their potent supplements. And Creatine Hardcore is no exception. Powered by cutting-edge micronization technology, Creatine Hardcore delivers explosive gains in muscle size and strength fast.
The Formula
Engineered by the authority of muscle performance supplementation - Chief Scientific Officer Dr. Marvin Heuer, Medical Director,  FAAFP - Creatine Hardcore is scientifically designed  for extreme results.
Each serving of Creatine Hardcore provides an incredibly effective dose of musclebuilding creatine to push the boundaries of muscle growth beyond their limits.

Creatine Hardcore goes to work fast after your very first serving, traveling through your blood into your muscle and boosting them for peak creatine levels.
Creatine Hardcore is manufactured at a state-of-the-art, U.S.A. federally-registered, GMP-certified production facility. Federal agency and verified with a third-party certificate of analysis to ensure you're getting the most potent, high-quality grade of creatine available on the market. Team MuscleTech spares no expenses when formulating advanced supplements that deliver the results you demand. Before manufacturing, all raw ingredients are  carefully inspected and tested for stability and freshness to make certain you get maximum results from every serving.
Team MuscleTech is completely dedicated to research and quality manufacturing. It stands behind its motto of producing only "Supplements that Work".

The Science
Working with top industry experts around the world, Team MuscleTech has funded over 100 research studies, including recent research trials at Baylor University, the University of Nottingham, the University of Laval, McMaster University, and the University of Toronto. The result of their research has led to the publication of 80 abstracts and 30 full papers in a variety of esteemed scientific journals. Furthermore, there are currently 31 issued patents and 100 patents pending protecting the cutting-edge formulas. The potent creatine found in Creatine Hardcore is proven in countless clinical research papers and ground-breaking human physiology studies to accelerate muscle growth and boost muscle strength.
In a 6-week clinical study conducted at a leading university, weight-training subjects using Creatine Hardcore gained, on average, a staggering 6 pounds of lean muscle, while the weight-training subjects in the placebo group only gained on average, 0.37 pounds. Creatine Hardcore is the ultimate advanced creatine formula for anyone serious about gaining muscle and getting strong extremely quickly.
MuscleTech: 8 Degrees of Quality: 
1. All manufacturing facilities are federally registered.
2. Label claims are verified through third-party testing, ensuring what is on the label is in the bottle.
3. All raw materials are inspected prior to manufacturing.
4. Stability tested to ensure freshness and label claim.
5. Finished product lots are verified and confirmed by certificates of analysis.
6. Engineered by industry leading doctors and research experts.
7. Clinically tested at University research labs.
8. 31 patents, 100 patents pending.

Multimillion-Dollar Research Budget
A portion of every dollar spent on MuscleTech supplements is allocated toward funding scientific research to discover new and more effective ways to increase lean muscle mass and strength, reduce bodyfat, and improve athletic performance.

Dietary Supplement

Directions: 1. For the first 5 days (loading phase); Mix 1 rounded teaspoon with 8 oz. of water and consume 4 times daily.
2. After day 5 (maintenance phase): Mix 1 rounded teaspoon with 8 oz. of water and consume twice daily.

This product is sold by weight. Some settling may occur.

As with all creatine products, maintain an adequate state of hydration during use.
